about: Spectacular deaths are rewards (docs/design/ARPG_FUN.md P1 item 5), read by logic/Sim/DeathShow.cs. An eligible kill (a crit, a blow of minBlow times what it had left, or an elite; never a boss) is shown at most share of the time, at most maxPerWindow shows each window seconds; once a single step has felled massFrom or more (a mass kill), that window may show up to massMaxPerWindow (F1 judge r1: 25 wolves felled at once fell plainly but for 3). A mass kill is one moment (F1 judge r2): every body it felled is re-shown, the first massMaxPerWindow thrown out from her (Launch, never a Burst) and the rest toppled, each leaving its feet within massTopple seconds of its hold ending (CrowdView). A shown kill is a Burst (blow of burstBlow or a crit of burstCritBlow, not fire) or else a Launch (thrown along the blow; launchBase + launchPerBlow * min(blow, launchBlowCap) metres, clamped to launchMin..launchMax).
